limits: Explicit synthetic contact only; no historical war declarations or enemy army AI.
Injury/capture/death, repeated engagement and remote non-recall commands are not yet implemented. Regroup60seconds/morale50 are trial coefficients.
Contact model and animation are engineering trials; numerical balance and nationwide battle performance are not accepted.
Fixed60fps capture is not a realtime performance benchmark.

Only the stated33 GPU checks were rerun: four reply cases and representative prior military/entry/transport families, old military/combat, ground and three smokes. Other older cases were not rerun in this slice.
Physical late handover of retained papers is a later slice; holding is not receipt or content knowledge.
Wide-view figures remain small and coincident labels overlap. Postal economics/health and nationwide mail/battle load are not accepted by this prototype.
The original automatic montage is preserved; review video was reordered chronologically from the same immutable captures without modifying game/source/test artifacts.
video_order: s0..s8, actual180consecutive frames froms8, s9..s11; nondecreasing simulation time

visual_review.method: Viewed actual final native-resolution Godot screenshots and four decoded chronological review frames. Main verifier also asserts264 exact numeric pose pairs and308 exact whole-world/image pairs.
observed: Failure report physically returns to last known unit sending point before same-original reply retry; old retained original and fresh retry carrier have independent positions.
Moved unit misses the report: no hidden following or false role knowledge, and carrier retains reply plus unreceived report at actual endpoint.
Initial lost TroopReply remains false while later common formal receipt reaches player once; timestamped body is not rewritten.
Wide models are small and labels overlap, especially in the near-rout scene; final HUD legibility/presentation is not accepted.
Review clip15seconds/900frames includes180 distinct consecutive actual frames; chronological milestone stills bracket the live segment. Fixed60fps capture is not a realtime performance benchmark.
visual_review.scope: 33GPU processes and1578 Core tests; only listed prior representative cases rerun. Physical held-paper late delivery and original/retry race continue next.
visual_review.video_correction: Initial automatic montage jumped back in simulation time after its s8 live segment. Original preserved with its hash; retained make-review-video.py produces s0..s8/live/s9..s11 chronology from identical captures. No game or verification-source change.
